meta_title: MemeBox: Meme Soundboard & Voice Changer for Calls
meta_desc: Free meme soundboard and voice changer for Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and Discord. Play meme sounds into your mic so everyone in the call hears them.
hero_lead: Click 😂 and a meme plays through your microphone, so everyone in the call hears it. Only you need MemeBox.
try_sub: Press a meme. In a real call, everyone would hear it through your mic.
feat_title: Everything you need to be the funny one
feat_sub: Meme lines, sound effects, your own clips and a voice changer, one click away during any call.
f1_p: A random meme on click, or pick from the panel. Alt+1 to Alt+9 for your favourites.
f2_p: Six tones from Chipmunk to Villain. The speech engine runs on your own computer.
f3_p: Chipmunk, Deep, Robot, Echo or Radio for your own voice. Alt+V turns it on and off.
f4_p: Give a meme a picture. It flashes on your screen, and on your camera for everyone to see.
f5_p: A funny YouTube moment? Send that tab's sound into the call. Nothing is downloaded.
f6_p: 12 languages and six color themes, from Dark to Neon. Plus your own clips and packs.
how_sub: No account, no setup. A short welcome page even tests your mic.
how1_p: Install it from the store in one click.
how2_p: Open Meet, Zoom, Teams or Discord in the browser. The 😂 button appears in the corner.
how3_p: The meme goes into your mic. Everyone hears it, and a big caption shows on your screen.

priv_text: Your microphone, camera and tab audio are only mixed inside your browser. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
q1: Do the others in the call need MemeBox?
a1: No. The meme goes out through your microphone, so they hear it like your voice.
q2: Does it work in the Zoom or Teams desktop app?
a2: No, only in the browser versions. Open your meeting link in Chrome or Edge.
q3: Why can't anyone hear the memes?
a3: Check that you're not muted in the call. Memes are silent while you're muted. If you just installed or updated MemeBox, reload the call tab once.
q4: How do I pay for Pro?
a4: With any UPI app (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM). Scan the QR code on the buy page, type the transaction ID, and your key appears once the payment is confirmed.
a5: Never. MemeBox only mixes sound inside your browser tab. Nothing is saved or sent anywhere.
